name: Garrick Runebearer
lore: A wandering male rune smith with a weathered beard and a hammer inscribed with three old promises: courage, swiftness and shelter.

primary.name: Rune Hammer
primary.description: Throw a spinning rune hammer for 24 damage. Walls stop it. Splash reaches 65 units around the impact.

secondary.name: Threefold Oath
secondary.description: Each use grants the next rune for 4.5s: Might (+20% damage), Stride (+30% movement), then Ward (35% less damage taken). Only one rune is active at a time. The next rune is shown beside you.

special.name: Triune Verdict
special.description: Mark a spot ahead. After warnings: a 24-damage hammer seal knocks foes back; a 28-damage crosscut slows; a 38-damage final ring stuns for 0.65s. Each strike has its own area; walls block damage.

passive: Purifying Rune: activating Ward removes burn, bleeding and poison from Garrick.

technique.name: Heavy Rune
technique.description: Rune Hammer hits 20% harder but travels 25% slower.

final_technique.name: Runic Judgement
final_technique.description: Charge one 80-damage runic lane with a short stun. Replaces the three-rune verdict with a telegraphed piercing line.

attack.name: Runic Judgement
attack.description: Charge one 80-damage runic lane with a short stun. Replaces the three-rune verdict with a telegraphed piercing line.
